what_this_is: The PREREGISTERED corpus required by directive §0 step 3-4. It is committed
DATA, not generated at run time, because a corpus assembled by the same run
that reports on it can be reshaped after the fact to fit its own result.
Written down first; run second; compared third.
⭐ THE BODY IS CALIBRATION, THE PROBES ARE THE EXPERIMENT. `body` must
reproduce production's MEASURED rung mix when run with
ENTITY_RESOLUTION_MODE=off, because off IS production today. If it does not
reproduce it, the corpus is not production-like and nothing measured through
it transfers. `probes` exist to exercise named invariants and are EXCLUDED
from the mix arithmetic — folding them in would corrupt the calibration, and
leaving them out entirely would miss the cases §0 step 3 names.
⭐⭐ MEMORY COVERAGE IS A PROPERTY OF REPETITION, NOT OF VOCABULARY. 43.7% of
real production entries reach the MEMORY rung because users log their staples
again, and the legacy path caches a seated candidate into user_food_matches on
the FIRST log. So the covered fraction here is produced by REPEAT TURNS BY THE
SAME SYNTHETIC USER — never by seeding rows. A seeded row would prove the
lookup works; only a repeat proves the loop that fills it works.
⚠ AND MEMORY IS PER-USER, so every repeat must be by the user that established
it. The `user` field is load-bearing, not decoration.
⛔⛔ EVERY REPEAT IS PHRASED AS A NEW EATING OCCASION, AND THAT IS NOT
STYLE — DO NOT 'SIMPLIFY' THESE BACK TO IDENTICAL STRINGS. The first smoke
run drove 8 turns and wrote 6 rows: the two repeats were IDENTICAL to their
establishing text, and the turn path correctly read them as double-taps and
deduplicated them. A compressed corpus makes a second meal look like a
client retry.
⭐ THE DEDUP IS RIGHT AND THE CORPUS WAS WRONG. In production a repeat is
hours or days later; here it is seconds. So the repeats carry the add-intent
a real user supplies at that moment — 'another', 'again', 'more', a changed
portion. Reverting them would silently delete the entire MEMORY population
and report it as a coverage finding.
⛔⛔⛔ EVERY BODY UTTERANCE CARRIES A PORTION, AND THAT IS THE THIRD THING THE
RUNS TAUGHT. A bare mention does not log — it ASKS. 'How much ground turkey,
roughly?' · 'Один кусок взяла или два?' — conversationally, NOT through the
structured pending-question path, which is why grepping the log for
clarification signals found nothing at all.
⭐ AND THE ASKS ACCUMULATE: 'We've got quite a stack now, salmon, turkey, eggs,
and home fries all waiting on details.' One unanswered ask blocks every later
turn for that user, so a single bare mention silently truncates the run.
⭐⭐ SO THE ASK/ANSWER LOOP MOVED TO THE PROBES, WHERE IT IS THE SUBJECT
RATHER THAN A CONFOUND. The body exists to measure the RUNG MIX; letting an
unanswered question decide which entries exist would measure the
conversation instead. P8 exercises the loop deliberately.

weighted_by.population: 687 real production food entries, 30 days, rung EXECUTED
weighted_by.note: the EXECUTED record is the weight source, not the simulated one — see directive §1e

target_mix_note: Percentages of ALL entries. The four uncovered buckets are counted ONLY for
entries that reach ESTIMATE_OR_REFUSE, exactly as scripts.measure_identity_
coverage does — so a Russian food that reaches MEMORY counts as MEMORY and
not as NON-ENGLISH. Uncovered pcts are restated against the 687-entry
executed run (215/68/52/39) rather than the 691-entry simulated one, so the
corpus and its target come from ONE population.
⛔ THE BUCKET IS NEVER READ FROM `declared`. It is computed by
scripts.measure_identity_coverage.classify on the food name the interpreter
ACTUALLY produced — the same _looks_branded heuristic and the same non-ASCII
test production uses. `declared` is a PREDICTION, and a disagreement between
prediction and classifier is reported as a corpus defect rather than
silently resolved in favour of either.

body_plan.how_memory_is_earned: 6 bare + 8 qualified establishers, then 44 repeats of those 14 by the same user
the_branded_repeats_are_a_prediction: Four of the ten BRANDED entries are REPEATS and are still declared BRANDED,
not MEMORY. That is deliberate and it is a falsifiable prediction about
production: 'Barebells Salty Peanut Protein Bar' appears four times in the
ten sampled BRANDED entries, so in real traffic a repeated branded log is
STILL missing — which can only mean retrieval never seats a candidate for
it, so nothing is ever cached to memory.
⭐ IF THIS RUN SHOWS THEM REACHING MEMORY, THE PREDICTION IS WRONG AND THAT
IS THE FINDING — it would mean the scratch run seats candidates production
does not, and every other number here would need re-reading in that light.
The run reports the disagreement; it does not relabel the entry to match.

probes_note: EXCLUDED FROM THE MIX. Each probe is a named invariant with a stated
expectation for BOTH modes, so a run cannot be read as confirming whichever
outcome it produced. `off` is today's production behaviour and is the
⭐ P2 IS THE HEADLINE AND IT IS WHY THE 'WAIT FOR TRAFFIC' BLOCKER WAS WRONG.
One food in two languages writes TWO memory rows today and ONE under the
boundary — observable in a scratch DB in minutes, with no organic volume.

probes.invariant: no false collapse across a digit-residue collision
probes.expect_off: both non-addressable under fac8f97 containment; творог reaches NO row, and specifically not the corn row
probes.expect_shadow: творог and corn address DIFFERENT canonical identities; творог still never reaches the corn row
probes.kills: the live misprice of 2026-08-14 — Творог 2% priced from boiled corn at 3.33 g protein

probes.invariant: one food in two languages is ONE memory
probes.expect_off: TWO user_food_matches rows — the Russian key is non-addressable, the English one is 'tomato'
probes.expect_shadow: ONE row, addressed by both surfaces
probes.kills: the 30.4% NON-ENGLISH bucket, measured rather than argued

probes.expect_off: three surface forms, no shared identity
probes.expect_shadow: turns 1 and 2 share ONE identity; turn 3 does NOT join them
probes.kills: a reuse step that merges everything would satisfy turn 2 perfectly and price 2% curd from 5% forever

probes.invariant: preparation materiality is a DIFFERENT row, never a defaulted one
probes.expect_off: mackerel| and mackerel|roasted are distinct artifact rows; egg| hits and eggs|fried MISSES
probes.expect_shadow: unchanged — materiality is an artifact property, not a resolution property
probes.kills: an unstated preparation silently acquiring one (A4), and records the plural gap eggs|fried

probes.invariant: an explicit quantity survives the turn unchanged
probes.expect_off: 150 g reaches the committed row as 150 g
probes.kills: A3's precursor — quantity drift at settlement

probes.invariant: bare and composed keys are different keys on the general path
probes.expect_off: chicken| vs chicken|fried and potato| vs potato|fried resolve to four distinct artifact entries
probes.kills: A4/A5's precursor — 'a potato is not fried'

probes.invariant: a branded product binds NO food identity
probes.expect_shadow: state=PRODUCT, canonical_entity_id EMPTY, and it enters no distinct set
probes.kills: a label being mistaken for a food identity — the PRODUCT rung has no producer and must not acquire one by accident

probes.invariant: a bare mention ASKS, and the answer completes the log
probes.expect_off: turn 1 writes NO row and asks for a portion; turn 2 answers it and the row appears carrying 200 g
probes.expect_shadow: unchanged — the ask/answer loop is not what the boundary changes
probes.kills: the assumption that a logged food and a mentioned food are the same event; unanswered asks accumulate and block every later turn

honest_limits: SYNTHETIC UTTERANCES, REAL FOOD NAMES. The food names are drawn from the
measured production samples in data/coverage/; the surrounding phrasing is
written. So this approximates WHAT users log, not HOW they type.
ONE ITEM PER TURN in the body, so entries ≈ turns. Production averages more
than one item per turn, and the coverage instrument counts entries. The
corpus matches the instrument, not the turn count.
THE REPEAT SCHEDULE IS COMPRESSED. Fourteen staples repeated inside one
session is not how a month of logging looks; it reaches the same rung by the
same mechanism in less wall-clock. Latency percentiles from this corpus are
therefore about the PATH, not about a production day's pacing.
MEMORY POPULATION DEPENDS ON LIVE RETRIEVAL. The legacy path caches a seated
candidate, and seating one needs USDA/OFF/web. If retrieval is unavailable
the covered fraction collapses — which the run's anti-vacuity gate reports
as a failure rather than as a coverage finding.
